_comment: Organs whose stale/dead-channel heartbeat is EXPECTED, not a real alarm: they run on-command only, not on a schedule. Excluded from the SessionStart heartbeat brief (scripts/hooks/organism_alert_sessionstart.sh) so a by-decision silence never re-creates the alert-fatigue the receptor exists to cure (cicatrix-superscar #2, the reverse case). Cross-referenced 2026-09-09 against apps/organism/organism/organs_registry.yaml: every wr2.*/pro.wr2_*/mata_garuda.wr2_bridge* entry there carries `enabled: false` with a `disabled_reason` naming the same ruling (Zero, 2026-09-01 — 'WR2 runs only on command', memory decision_wr2_runs_only_on_command_2026_09_01). The live ~/.organism/last_seen/ sidecar organ_ids do not all match the registry's `id` field 1:1 (e.g. pro.wr2_wrapper_guard.<owner_module> wrapper stamps are not separate registry entries), so exclusion here is by PATTERN (fnmatch glob against organ_id), not exact id. Audit this file if organs_registry.yaml's WR2 manual-only set changes, or if WR2 is ever re-armed on a schedule (Zero's call, not a hook's).
